title: Close-up witnesses sensed being watched

tellings.quote: I've had some folks I talked to that had their own kind of up close kind of sightings. They said that they got that vibe, too,

plain: People who had close-up UFO sightings told David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer, that they had a feeling of being watched. Grusch says on the show that "some folks I talked to" with up-close sightings "got that vibe, too," and he passes it on as what they told him, without naming them.
